1879064254.name: Fire and Frost Lore
1879064254.desc: Your knowledge of the elements is able to weaken and dismay your foe, reducing their Outgoing Damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Using a Lore skill will briefly reduce your Incoming Damage

1879064382.name: Purge Poison
1879064382.desc: Purges poisons from an ally or yourself.

1879073470.name: Throw Stone
1879073470.desc: This grants you a short ranged attack.

1879102782.name: Guile Signal
1879102782.desc: Extends Guile fellowship skill bonus to your fellowship.

1879131582.name: Resolution
1879131582.desc: Even in the face of overwhelming numbers, your resolution dismays your foes, draining morale from enemies around you and restoring your morale.

1879139390.name: Sting
1879139390.desc: A quick attack that will lightly wound your opponent.

1879212094.name: Bucket of Fear
1879212094.desc: The only thing to fear is...a crazy person with a bucket on his head.

1879213886.name: A Slight Sting (Tactical)
1879213886.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's rear left leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879215038.name: Crude Map to Tírith Rhaw
1879215038.desc: A crudely drawn and horribly detailed map to Tírith Rhaw.

conditionalEffects.description: Chord of Salvation will grant your target 1% of their Max Morale for every nearby ally.

1879227838.name: Ring of Acid
1879227838.desc: Wield the power of Acid to assault Saruman by stripping defences.

1879231422.name: Ranged Unerring Strike
1879231422.desc: A targeted strike that is very difficult to avoid and deals potent damage for a long time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879233854.name: War-steed: Light
1879233854.desc: The Courser is a lightly armoured War-steed. Fast and agile, the Courser provides the greatest speed and maneuverability on the battlefield, trading Endurance and Armour to retain their nimbleness.

1879244862.name: Assault of the Eorlingas
1879244862.desc: A violent strike against the target that focuses on your offensive capability, this skill is executed at range.\n\n<rgb=#66ffff>Applies the Lance effect to you. Skill of the Eorlingas becomes Lancer's Charge.</rgb>

1879245630.name: Invoke the Elements
1879245630.desc: Calling upon etchings representing the elements, the Rune-keeper composes a symbol with disastrous intent.

1879247806.name: Swift Cut
1879247806.desc: A swift slice against an opponent dealing a little damage up front with a hefty bleed to follow.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879267646.name: Small Fish-Net
1879267646.desc: Throw a small net to catch fish.

1879302590.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Oath-bound)
1879302590.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879344574.name: Floral Kite
1879344574.desc: Brings out a floral kite for you to fly!

1879411774.name: Gut Punch
1879411774.desc: An uncompromising strike to the gut leaves your enemy reeling and unable to effectively defend themselves for a time.\n\nApplies a damage debuff. A given target will be on guard and immune to this debuff for 70 seconds after it wears off.

procEffects.description: When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a modest Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff
When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a significant Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a powerful Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff
DNT - Spenders have a chance to trigger a bonus light-type damage effect after a short delay.

1879414206.name: Winter Hobby-deer
1879414206.desc: A creative winter toy.\n\nYou may ride it in most towns and cities.

1879420862.name: Mushroom Nether-hound
1879420862.desc: Summons a nether-hound to help you search caverns and other tight spaces.

1879446334.name: Muster at Nobottle
1879446334.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Nobottle

1879452350.name: Loyal Turtle
1879452350.desc: Summons an adorable turtle to accompany you on your journeys.

1879459390.name: Test Healing VPS
1879459390.desc: Does fixed effect to test buffs and mitigations.

1879462974.name: Black Miniature Draught Horse
1879462974.desc: Summons a strong young horse to accompany you on your journeys.

1879482558.name: Adorable Sand Worm
1879482558.desc: Summons an adorable sand worm to accompany you on your travels.

1879491518.name: Guide to Iridír
1879491518.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Iridír in Ambarûl in the Ikorbân Valley.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879522366.name: Call to Greatness
1879522366.desc: You call out to your fellows, pushing yourself through pain to achieve impossible feats.

1879522622.name: Perfect Ballad
1879522622.desc: Heals you and harms your foe.\n\nBallads unlock Anthems and Codas.
